verdict.rationale: The axis applies, because an evaluation SaaS platform could ship a built-in assistant. The closest evidence is Worldsmith, which builds simulated worlds from a natural-language description, delegating one specific task to built-in AI. Marketing also claims autonomous fix and rollback for monitored production agents. Neither is documented as a general in-product assistant you can hand arbitrary tasks to. Missing for 10: a general-purpose built-in assistant for delegating tasks across the product, documentation of how Worldsmith is invoked and what it can do, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
